import Acl.Spec
namespace Acl
instance instDecidableValidQuery (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidQuery s r) := by
  unfold ValidQuery; infer_instance
def matchesB (e : Entry) (r : Request) : Bool :=
  (e.subject == 0 || e.subject == r.user) && e.path.isPrefixOf r.path

/-- Depth of the most specific matching entry with effect `eff`. -/
def best (eff : Effect) (r : Request) (l : List Entry) : Option Nat :=
  (l.filter (fun e => matchesB e r && e.effect == eff)).foldl
    (fun m e => some (max (m.getD 0) (depth e))) none

def decision (l : List Entry) (r : Request) : Bool :=
  match best .allow r l, best .deny r l with
  | some _, none => true
  | some a, some d => d < a
  | none, _ => false

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if s.users.contains r.user && r.user != 0 then
    let g := decision s.entries r
    (if g then .granted else .denied, { s with log := s.log ++ [⟨r.user, r.path, g⟩] })
  else (.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_answered     : ValidAnswered step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop       : InvalidNoop step := sorry

theorem req_effects            : Effects step := sorry

theorem req_default_deny       : DefaultDeny step := sorry

theorem req_deny_overrides     : DenyOverrides step := sorry

theorem req_specific_allow     : SpecificAllow step := sorry

theorem req_grant_justified    : GrantJustified step := sorry

theorem req_order_independent  : OrderIndependent step := sorry

theorem req_denial_explained   : DenialExplained step := sorry

end Acl

import Acl.Spec

namespace Acl

instance instDecidableValidQuery (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidQuery s r) := by
  unfold ValidQuery; infer_instance

instance instDecidableMatches (e : Entry) (r : Request) : Decidable (Matches e r) := by
  unfold Matches; infer_instance

instance instDecidableHasAllow (l : List Entry) (r : Request) : Decidable (HasAllow l r) := by
  unfold HasAllow; infer_instance

instance instDecidableOverridden (l : List Entry) (r : Request) : Decidable (Overridden l r) := by
  unfold Overridden; infer_instance

instance instDecidablePermitted (l : List Entry) (r : Request) : Decidable (Permitted l r) := by
  unfold Permitted; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if _h : ValidQuery s r then
    let g := decide (Permitted s.entries r)
    (if g then .granted else .denied, { s with log := s.log ++ [⟨r.user, r.path, g⟩] })
  else (.rejected, s)

theorem permitted_perm {l₁ l₂ : List Entry} (h : l₁.Perm l₂) (r : Request) :
    Permitted l₁ r ↔ Permitted l₂ r := by
  unfold Permitted
  have hm : ∀ x, x ∈ l₁ ↔ x ∈ l₂ := fun x => h.mem_iff
  constructor
  · intro h1
    rcases h1 with ⟨a, ha, h1, h2, h3⟩
    exact ⟨a, (hm a).mp ha, h1, h2, fun d hd h4 h5 => h3 d ((hm d).mpr hd) h4 h5⟩
  · intro h1
    rcases h1 with ⟨a, ha, h1, h2, h3⟩
    exact ⟨a, (hm a).mpr ha, h1, h2, fun d hd h4 h5 => h3 d ((hm d).mp hd) h4 h5⟩

theorem permitted_imp_hasAllow {l : List Entry} {r : Request} (h : Permitted l r) : HasAllow l r := by
  unfold Permitted at h
  unfold HasAllow
  rcases h with ⟨a, ha, hm, he, _⟩
  exact ⟨a, ha, hm, he⟩

theorem not_permitted_of_overridden {l : List Entry} {r : Request}
    (ho : Overridden l r) : ¬ Permitted l r := by
  unfold Overridden at ho
  unfold Permitted
  intro h2
  rcases ho with ⟨d, hd, hmd, hed, hall⟩
  rcases h2 with ⟨a, ha, hma, hea, hall2⟩
  have h1 := hall a ha hma hea
  have h2' := hall2 d hd hmd hed
  exact absurd (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2') (Nat.lt_irrefl _)

theorem exists_max_entry (p : Entry → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (l : List Entry)
    (h : ∃ e ∈ l, p e) : ∃ m ∈ l, p m ∧ ∀ e ∈ l, p e → depth e ≤ depth m := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    exfalso
    obtain ⟨e, he, _⟩ := h
    simp at he
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    by_cases hp : p hd
    · by_cases ht : ∃ e ∈ tl, p e
      · obtain ⟨m, hm, hpm, hall⟩ := ih ht
        by_cases hle : depth hd ≤ depth m
        · refine ⟨m, List.Mem.tail hd hm, hpm, fun e he hpe => ?_⟩
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with rfl | he2
          · exact hle
          · exact hall e he2 hpe
        · have hgt : depth m ≤ depth hd := Nat.le_of_not_le hle
          refine ⟨hd, List.Mem.head tl, hp, fun e he hpe => ?_⟩
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with rfl | he2
          · exact Nat.le_refl _
          · exact Nat.le_trans (hall e he2 hpe) hgt
      · refine ⟨hd, List.Mem.head tl, hp, fun e he hpe => ?_⟩
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with rfl | he2
        · exact Nat.le_refl _
        · exfalso
          exact ht ⟨e, he2, hpe⟩
    · have ht : ∃ e ∈ tl, p e := by
        obtain ⟨e, he, hpe⟩ := h
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with rfl | he2
        · exact absurd hpe hp
        · exact ⟨e, he2, hpe⟩
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hpm, hall⟩ := ih ht
      refine ⟨m, List.Mem.tail hd hm, hpm, fun e he hpe => ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with rfl | he2
      · exact absurd hpe hp
      · exact hall e he2 hpe

theorem hasAllow_notPermitted_imp_overridden (l : List Entry) (r : Request)
    (ha : HasAllow l r) (hnp : ¬ Permitted l r) : Overridden l r := by
  have hallows : ∃ e ∈ l, (Matches e r ∧ e.effect = .allow) := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha1, hm, he⟩ := ha
    exact ⟨a, ha1, ⟨hm, he⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨aMax, haMaxMem, hpaMax, haMaxGreatest⟩ :=
    exists_max_entry (fun e => Matches e r ∧ e.effect = .allow) l hallows
  by_cases hDenExists : ∃ e ∈ l, (Matches e r ∧ e.effect = .deny)
  · obtain ⟨dMax, hdMaxMem, hpdMax, hdMaxGreatest⟩ :=
      exists_max_entry (fun e => Matches e r ∧ e.effect = .deny) l hDenExists
    have hdMaxMatch := hpdMax.1
    have hdMaxEff := hpdMax.2
    have haMaxMatch := hpaMax.1
    have haMaxEff := hpaMax.2
    have h_over_aMax : depth aMax ≤ depth dMax := by
      by_cases hle : depth aMax ≤ depth dMax
      · exact hle
      · exfalso
        have hlt' : depth dMax < depth aMax := Nat.lt_of_not_le hle
        have hPerm : Permitted l r :=
          ⟨aMax, haMaxMem, haMaxMatch, haMaxEff, fun d hd hmd hed => by
            have hleD := hdMaxGreatest d hd ⟨hmd, hed⟩
            exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hleD hlt'⟩
        exact hnp hPerm
    exact ⟨dMax, hdMaxMem, hdMaxMatch, hdMaxEff, fun a ha hma hea => by
      have hleA : depth a ≤ depth aMax := haMaxGreatest a ha ⟨hma, hea⟩
      exact Nat.le_trans hleA h_over_aMax⟩
  · exfalso
    have hPerm : Permitted l r :=
      ⟨aMax, haMaxMem, hpaMax.1, hpaMax.2, fun d hd hmd hed => by
        exfalso
        exact hDenExists ⟨d, hd, ⟨hmd, hed⟩⟩⟩
    exact hnp hPerm

theorem notPermitted_imp (l : List Entry) (r : Request) :
    ¬ Permitted l r → (¬ HasAllow l r ∨ Overridden l r) := by
  intro h
  by_cases ha : HasAllow l r
  · exact Or.inr (hasAllow_notPermitted_imp_overridden l r ha h)
  · exact Or.inl ha

theorem step_of_valid (s : State) (r : Request) (hv : ValidQuery s r) :
    step s r = (if decide (Permitted s.entries r) then .granted else .denied,
                { s with log := s.log ++ [⟨r.user, r.path, decide (Permitted s.entries r)⟩] }) := by
  unfold step
  simp [hv]

theorem step_of_invalid (s : State) (r : Request) (hn : ¬ ValidQuery s r) :
    step s r = (.rejected, s) := by
  unfold step
  simp [hn]

theorem step_fst_of_valid (s : State) (r : Request) (hv : ValidQuery s r) :
    (step s r).1 = if decide (Permitted s.entries r) then .granted else .denied := by
  rw [step_of_valid s r hv]

theorem step_fst_of_invalid (s : State) (r : Request) (hn : ¬ ValidQuery s r) :
    (step s r).1 = .rejected := by
  rw [step_of_invalid s r hn]

theorem valid_of_not_rejected (s : State) (r : Request) (hne : (step s r).1 ≠ .rejected) :
    ValidQuery s r := by
  by_cases hv : ValidQuery s r
  · exact hv
  · exfalso
    have hs := step_fst_of_invalid s r hv
    rw [hs] at hne
    exact hne rfl

theorem permitted_of_granted_valid (s : State) (r : Request) (hv : ValidQuery s r)
    (hgr : (step s r).1 = .granted) : Permitted s.entries r := by
  have hs := step_fst_of_valid s r hv
  rw [hs] at hgr
  by_cases hp : Permitted s.entries r
  · exact hp
  · simp [hp] at hgr

theorem not_permitted_of_denied_valid (s : State) (r : Request) (hv : ValidQuery s r)
    (hden : (step s r).1 = .denied) : ¬ Permitted s.entries r := by
  have hs := step_fst_of_valid s r hv
  rw [hs] at hden
  by_cases hp : Permitted s.entries r
  · simp [hp] at hden
  · exact hp

theorem req_valid_answered : ValidAnswered step := by
  unfold ValidAnswered
  intro s r hv
  have h := step_fst_of_valid s r hv
  rw [h]
  by_cases hp : Permitted s.entries r <;> simp [hp]

theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by
  unfold InvalidNoop
  intro s r hn
  exact step_of_invalid s r hn

theorem req_effects : Effects step := by
  unfold Effects
  intro s r hne
  have hv : ValidQuery s r := valid_of_not_rejected s r hne
  have hs := step_of_valid s r hv
  rw [hs]
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  have hg : decide ((if decide (Permitted s.entries r) then Outcome.granted else Outcome.denied) = Outcome.granted) = decide (Permitted s.entries r) := by
    by_cases hp : Permitted s.entries r
    · simp [hp]
    · simp [hp]
  rw [hg]

theorem req_default_deny : DefaultDeny step := by
  unfold DefaultDeny
  intro s r hna hgr
  have hv : ValidQuery s r := valid_of_not_rejected s r (by rw [hgr]; simp)
  have hPerm := permitted_of_granted_valid s r hv hgr
  exact hna (permitted_imp_hasAllow hPerm)

theorem req_deny_overrides : DenyOverrides step := by
  unfold DenyOverrides
  intro s r ho hgr
  have hv : ValidQuery s r := valid_of_not_rejected s r (by rw [hgr]; simp)
  have hPerm := permitted_of_granted_valid s r hv hgr
  exact not_permitted_of_overridden ho hPerm

theorem req_specific_allow : SpecificAllow step := by
  unfold SpecificAllow
  intro s r hvq hp
  have hs := step_of_valid s r hvq
  rw [hs]
  simp [hp]

theorem req_grant_justified : GrantJustified step := by
  unfold GrantJustified
  intro s r h
  have hv : ValidQuery s r := valid_of_not_rejected s r (by rw [h]; simp)
  exact permitted_of_granted_valid s r hv h

theorem req_order_independent : OrderIndependent step := by
  unfold OrderIndependent
  intro s r l hperm
  have hv1 : ValidQuery s r ↔ ValidQuery { s with entries := l } r := by
    unfold ValidQuery
    simp
  by_cases hvq : ValidQuery s r
  · have hvq2 : ValidQuery { s with entries := l } r := hv1.mp hvq
    have hs1 := step_of_valid s r hvq
    have hs2 := step_of_valid { s with entries := l } r hvq2
    rw [hs1, hs2]
    simp
    have hiff := permitted_perm hperm r
    by_cases hp : Permitted s.entries r
    · have hp2 : Permitted l r := hiff.mpr hp
      simp [hp, hp2]
    · have hp2 : ¬ Permitted l r := fun h => hp (hiff.mp h)
      simp [hp, hp2]
  · have hvq2 : ¬ ValidQuery { s with entries := l } r := fun h => hvq (hv1.mpr h)
    have hs1 := step_of_invalid s r hvq
    have hs2 := step_of_invalid { s with entries := l } r hvq2
    rw [hs1, hs2]

theorem req_denial_explained : DenialExplained step := by
  unfold DenialExplained
  intro s r hden
  have hv : ValidQuery s r := valid_of_not_rejected s r (by rw [hden]; simp)
  have hnp := not_permitted_of_denied_valid s r hv hden
  exact notPermitted_imp s.entries r hnp

end Acl

instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by

import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants

instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if _h : ValidCommand s r then
    (.ok, { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r })
  else
    (.rejected, s)

private theorem step_ok_iff (s : State) (r : Request) : (step s r).1 = .ok ↔ ValidCommand s r := by
  unfold step
  by_cases h : ValidCommand s r <;> simp [h]

private theorem step_eq_ok_branch (s : State) (r : Request) (h : ValidCommand s r) :
    step s r = (.ok, { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r }) := by
  unfold step; simp [h]

private theorem step_eq_rejected_branch (s : State) (r : Request) (h : ¬ValidCommand s r) :
    step s r = (.rejected, s) := by
  unfold step; simp [h]

theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := by
  intro s r hv
  have := step_eq_ok_branch s r hv
  simp [this]

theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s r hn
  exact step_eq_rejected_branch s r hn

theorem req_authorization : AdminOnly step := by
  intro s r hok
  have hv : ValidCommand s r := (step_ok_iff s r).mp hok
  unfold ValidCommand at hv
  rcases hv with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩
  exact ⟨h1, h3⟩

theorem req_no_self_grant : NoSelfGrant step := by
  intro s r hok hgrant
  have hv : ValidCommand s r := (step_ok_iff s r).mp hok
  unfold ValidCommand at hv
  rcases hv with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩
  exact (h4 hgrant).1

theorem req_others_unchanged : OthersUnchanged step := by
  intro s r hok u q hneq
  have hv : ValidCommand s r := (step_ok_iff s r).mp hok
  have heq := step_eq_ok_branch s r hv
  have husers : (step s r).2 = ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State) := by
    simp [heq]
  have hhas : (step s r).2.has u q = (expectedHas s r u q) := by
    simp [husers]
  rw [hhas]
  unfold expectedHas
  have hcond : ¬(u = r.target ∧ q = r.role) := by
    intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hu, hq⟩
    rcases hneq with h1 | h1
    · exact h1 hu
    · exact h1 hq
  simp [hcond]

theorem req_effects : Effects step := by
  intro s r hok
  have hv : ValidCommand s r := (step_ok_iff s r).mp hok
  have heq := step_eq_ok_branch s r hv
  constructor
  · simp [heq]
  · intro u q
    have hhas : (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q := by
      simp [heq]
    exact hhas

theorem req_idempotency : Idempotent step := by
  intro s r hok
  have hv : ValidCommand s r := (step_ok_iff s r).mp hok
  have heq := step_eq_ok_branch s r hv
  have hs' : (step s r).2 = ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State) := by
    simp [heq]
  have hnot : ¬ValidCommand ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State) r := by
    intro h
    unfold ValidCommand at hv h
    rcases hv with ⟨hA1, hT1, hadm1, hg1, hr1⟩
    rcases h with ⟨hA2, hT2, hadm2, hg2, hr2⟩
    cases hop : r.op with
    | grant =>
      have hg2' := hg2 hop
      have h_has : (expectedHas s r r.target r.role) = true := by
        unfold expectedHas; simp [hop]
      have h1 : (expectedHas s r r.target r.role) = false := hg2'.2
      rw [h_has] at h1
      contradiction
    | revoke =>
      have h_has : (expectedHas s r r.target r.role) = false := by
        unfold expectedHas; simp [hop]
      have h1 : (expectedHas s r r.target r.role) = true := (hr2 hop).1
      rw [h_has] at h1
      contradiction
  have hstep' : step ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State) r = (.rejected, ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State)) :=
    step_eq_rejected_branch _ r hnot
  rw [hs', hstep']

theorem req_last_admin : KeepsAdmin step := by
  intro s r hex
  by_cases hv : ValidCommand s r
  · have heq := step_eq_ok_branch s r hv
    have husers : (step s r).2.users = s.users := by simp [heq]
    cases hop : r.op with
    | grant =>
      rcases hex with ⟨u, hu, hadm⟩
      refine ⟨u, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [husers]; exact hu
      · have hhas : (step s r).2.has u .admin = expectedHas s r u .admin := by simp [heq]
        rw [hhas]
        unfold expectedHas
        by_cases hcond : u = r.target ∧ (Role.admin = r.role)
        · have _hrole_eq : Role.admin = r.role := hcond.2
          simp [hcond, hop]
        · simp [hcond, hadm]
    | revoke =>
      by_cases hrole : r.role = .admin
      · unfold ValidCommand at hv
        rcases hv with ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩
        have hother : OtherAdmin s r.target := (h5 hop).2 hrole
        rcases hother with ⟨v, hv_mem, hv_neq, hv_adm⟩
        refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [husers]; exact hv_mem
        · have hhas : (step s r).2.has v .admin = expectedHas s r v .admin := by simp [heq]
          rw [hhas]
          unfold expectedHas
          have hcond : ¬(v = r.target ∧ Role.admin = r.role) := by
            intro h
            exact hv_neq h.1
          simp [hcond, hv_adm]
      · rcases hex with ⟨u, hu, hadm⟩
        refine ⟨u, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [husers]; exact hu
        · have hhas : (step s r).2.has u .admin = expectedHas s r u .admin := by simp [heq]
          rw [hhas]
          unfold expectedHas
          by_cases hcond : u = r.target ∧ Role.admin = r.role
          · exfalso; exact hrole hcond.2.symm
          · simp [hcond, hadm]
  · have heq := step_eq_rejected_branch s r hv
    rcases hex with ⟨u, hu, hadm⟩
    refine ⟨u, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [heq, hu]
    · simp [heq, hadm]

end Grants

import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants

instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance

def otherAdminBool (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool :=
  s.users.any (fun v => decide (v ≠ u) && s.has v .admin)

-- helper: for any Bool predicate, any = true iff exists
theorem otherAdminBool_true_iff (s : State) (u : UserId) :
    otherAdminBool s u = true ↔ OtherAdmin s u := by
  unfold otherAdminBool OtherAdmin
  rw [List.any_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨v, hv_mem, hv_true⟩ := h
    have hv : decide (v ≠ u) && s.has v .admin = true := hv_true
    have h1 : decide (v ≠ u) = true := by
      cases d : decide (v ≠ u) with
      | true => rfl
      | false => simp [d] at hv
    have h2 : s.has v .admin = true := by simp [h1] at hv; exact hv
    exact ⟨v, hv_mem, of_decide_eq_true h1, h2⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨v, hv_mem, hv_neq, hv_adm⟩ := h
    exact ⟨v, hv_mem, by simp [hv_neq, hv_adm]⟩

def validBool (s : State) (r : Request) : Bool :=
  decide (r.actor ∈ s.users) &&
  decide (r.target ∈ s.users) &&
  s.has r.actor .admin &&
  (match r.op with
   | .grant => decide (r.actor ≠ r.target) && decide (s.has r.target r.role = false)
   | .revoke => s.has r.target r.role && (if r.role == .admin then otherAdminBool s r.target else true))

theorem validBool_true_iff (s : State) (r : Request) :
    validBool s r = true ↔ ValidCommand s r := by
  unfold validBool ValidCommand
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩ := h
    have ha : r.actor ∈ s.users := of_decide_eq_true h1
    have ht : r.target ∈ s.users := of_decide_eq_true h2
    refine ⟨ha, ht, h3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hgrant
      have h4g : (match (Op.grant : Op) with | .grant => decide (r.actor ≠ r.target) && decide (s.has r.target r.role = false) | .revoke => s.has r.target r.role && (if r.role == .admin then otherAdminBool s r.target else true)) = true := by rw [← hgrant]; exact h4
      simp only at h4g
      simpa [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] using h4g
    · intro hrev
      have h4r : (match (Op.revoke : Op) with | .grant => decide (r.actor ≠ r.target) && decide (s.has r.target r.role = false) | .revoke => s.has r.target r.role && (if r.role == .admin then otherAdminBool s r.target else true)) = true := by rw [← hrev]; exact h4
      simp only at h4r
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h4r
      obtain ⟨hhas, hother⟩ := h4r
      refine ⟨hhas, ?_⟩
      intro hrole
      have hroleB : (r.role == .admin) = true := by simp [hrole]
      have hother2 : otherAdminBool s r.target = true := by simp [hroleB] at hother; exact hother
      exact (otherAdminBool_true_iff s r.target).mp hother2
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨ha, ht, hadm, hg, hr⟩ := h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true]
    refine ⟨⟨⟨decide_eq_true ha, decide_eq_true ht⟩, hadm⟩, ?_⟩
    cases hop : r.op with
    | grant =>
      have hh := hg hop
      simp [hop, hh.1, hh.2]
    | revoke =>
      have hh := hr hop
      simp only [hop, Bool.and_eq_true, hh.1, true_and]
      by_cases hrole : r.role = .admin
      · have hbeq : (r.role == .admin) = true := by simp [hrole]
        simp [hbeq, (otherAdminBool_true_iff s r.target).mpr (hh.2 hrole)]
      · have hbeq : (r.role == .admin) = false := by
          cases hc : r.role with
          | admin => contradiction
          | editor => rfl
          | viewer => rfl
        simp [hbeq]

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  match validBool s r with
  | true => (.ok, { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r })
  | false => (.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := by
  intro s r h
  show (step s r).1 = .ok
  unfold step
  have hv : validBool s r = true := (validBool_true_iff s r).mpr h
  simp [hv]

theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s r h
  show step s r = (.rejected, s)
  unfold step
  have hv : validBool s r = false := by
    cases hb : validBool s r with
    | true => exact absurd ((validBool_true_iff s r).mp hb) h
    | false => rfl
  simp [hv]

theorem req_authorization : AdminOnly step := by
  intro s r hok
  show r.actor ∈ s.users ∧ s.has r.actor .admin = true
  unfold step at hok
  by_cases hv : validBool s r = true
  · have hvc : ValidCommand s r := (validBool_true_iff s r).mp hv
    simp [hv] at hok; exact ⟨hvc.1, hvc.2.2.1⟩
  · simp [hv] at hok

theorem req_no_self_grant : NoSelfGrant step := by
  intro s r hok hgrant
  show r.actor ≠ r.target
  unfold step at hok
  by_cases hv : validBool s r = true
  · have hvc : ValidCommand s r := (validBool_true_iff s r).mp hv
    simp [hv] at hok; exact (hvc.2.2.2.1 hgrant).1
  · simp [hv] at hok

theorem req_others_unchanged : OthersUnchanged step := by
  intro s r hok u q hneq
  show (step s r).2.has u q = s.has u q
  unfold step at hok ⊢
  by_cases hv : validBool s r = true
  · simp [hv] at hok ⊢
    show expectedHas s r u q = s.has u q
    unfold expectedHas
    have hcond : ¬(u = r.target ∧ q = r.role) := by
      intro ⟨a, b⟩; rcases hneq with h1 | h2; exact h1 a; exact h2 b
    simp [hcond]
  · simp [hv] at hok

theorem req_effects : Effects step := by
  intro s r hok
  show (step s r).2.users = s.users ∧ ∀ u q, (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q
  unfold step at hok ⊢
  by_cases hv : validBool s r = true
  · simp [hv] at hok ⊢
  · simp [hv] at hok

theorem req_idempotency : Idempotent step := by
  intro s r hok
  show step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2)
  unfold step at hok ⊢
  by_cases hv : validBool s r = true
  · simp [hv] at hok ⊢
    suffices validBool { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } r = false by simp [this]
    cases hb : validBool { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } r with
    | true =>
      have hvc2 : ValidCommand { users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } r := (validBool_true_iff _ _).mp hb
      cases hop : r.op with
      | grant =>
        have hg2 := (hvc2.2.2.2.1 hop)
        have h1 : expectedHas s r r.target r.role = true := by unfold expectedHas; simp [hop]
        have h2 : expectedHas s r r.target r.role = false := hg2.2
        rw [h1] at h2; contradiction
      | revoke =>
        have hr2 := (hvc2.2.2.2.2 hop)
        have h1 : expectedHas s r r.target r.role = false := by unfold expectedHas; simp [hop]
        have h2 : expectedHas s r r.target r.role = true := hr2.1
        rw [h1] at h2; contradiction
    | false => rfl
  · simp [hv] at hok

theorem req_last_admin : KeepsAdmin step := by
  intro s r hex
  show ∃ u ∈ (step s r).2.users, (step s r).2.has u .admin = true
  unfold step
  by_cases hv : validBool s r = true
  · simp [hv]
    have hvc : ValidCommand s r := (validBool_true_iff s r).mp hv
    cases hop : r.op with
    | grant =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu_mem, hu_admin⟩ := hex
      refine ⟨u, hu_mem, ?_⟩; unfold expectedHas
      by_cases heq : u = r.target ∧ Role.admin = r.role
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := heq; subst h1; rw [← h2]; simp [hop]
      · simp [heq, hu_admin]
    | revoke =>
      by_cases hrole : r.role = .admin
      · have hother : OtherAdmin s r.target := (hvc.2.2.2.2 hop).2 hrole
        obtain ⟨v, hv_mem, hv_neq, hv_admin⟩ := hother
        refine ⟨v, hv_mem, ?_⟩; unfold expectedHas
        have hneq : ¬(v = r.target ∧ Role.admin = .admin) := by intro h; exact hv_neq h.1
        simp [hrole] at hneq ⊢; simp [hneq, hv_admin]
      · obtain ⟨u, hu_mem, hu_admin⟩ := hex
        refine ⟨u, hu_mem, ?_⟩; unfold expectedHas
        by_cases heq : u = r.target ∧ Role.admin = r.role
        · have : r.role = .admin := heq.2.symm; contradiction
        · simp [heq, hu_admin]
  · simp [hv]; exact hex

end Grants

import Acl.Spec
namespace Acl
instance instDecidableValidQuery (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidQuery s r) := by
  unfold ValidQuery; infer_instance

def matchesB (e : Entry) (r : Request) : Bool :=
  (e.subject == 0 || e.subject == r.user) && e.path.isPrefixOf r.path

def maxDepth (l : List Entry) : Nat :=
  l.foldl (fun acc e => max acc e.path.length) 0

def decision (l : List Entry) (r : Request) : Bool :=
  let allows := l.filter (fun e => matchesB e r && decide (e.effect = .allow))
  let denies := l.filter (fun e => matchesB e r && decide (e.effect = .deny))
  if allows.isEmpty then false
  else if denies.isEmpty then true
  else decide (maxDepth denies < maxDepth allows)

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if s.users.contains r.user && r.user != 0 then
    let g := decision s.entries r
    (if g then .granted else .denied, { s with log := s.log ++ [⟨r.user, r.path, g⟩] })
  else (.rejected, s)

import Acl.Spec
namespace Acl
instance instDecidableValidQuery (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidQuery s r) := by unfold ValidQuery; infer_instance
noncomputable instance instDecMatches (e : Entry) (r : Request) : Decidable (Matches e r) := Classical.propDecidable _
noncomputable instance instDecPermitted (l : List Entry) (r : Request) : Decidable (Permitted l r) := Classical.propDecidable _
noncomputable instance instDecHasAllow (l : List Entry) (r : Request) : Decidable (HasAllow l r) := Classical.propDecidable _
noncomputable instance instDecExistsDeny (l : List Entry) (r : Request) (n : Nat) : Decidable (∃ d ∈ l, Matches d r ∧ d.effect = Effect.deny ∧ n ≤ depth d) := Classical.propDecidable _

noncomputable def decision (l : List Entry) (r : Request) : Bool := decide (Permitted l r)

noncomputable def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if _h : ValidQuery s r then
    ((if decision s.entries r then Outcome.granted else Outcome.denied),
     { s with log := s.log ++ [⟨r.user, r.path, decision s.entries r⟩] })
  else (Outcome.rejected, s)

theorem overridden_not_permitted {l : List Entry} {r : Request} (h : Overridden l r) : ¬ Permitted l r := by
  intro hp
  obtain ⟨d, hdmem, hdmat, hdeff, hall⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a, hamem, hamat, haeff, hall2⟩ := hp
  have hle : depth a ≤ depth d := hall a hamem hamat haeff
  have hlt : depth d < depth a := hall2 d hdmem hdmat hdeff
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hle hlt)

theorem hasAllow_of_permitted {l : List Entry} {r : Request} (h : Permitted l r) : HasAllow l r := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hm, he, _⟩ := h
  exact ⟨a, ha, hm, he⟩

theorem not_permitted_of_not_hasAllow {l : List Entry} {r : Request} (h : ¬ HasAllow l r) : ¬ Permitted l r :=
  fun hp => h (hasAllow_of_permitted hp)

theorem exists_max_allow {l : List Entry} {r : Request} (hHas : HasAllow l r) : ∃ a₀ ∈ l, Matches a₀ r ∧ a₀.effect = Effect.allow ∧ ∀ a ∈ l, Matches a r → a.effect = Effect.allow → depth a ≤ depth a₀ := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [HasAllow] at hHas
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    by_cases hhd : Matches hd r ∧ hd.effect = Effect.allow
    · by_cases htl : HasAllow tl r
      · obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁, hm₁, he₁, hmax₁⟩ := ih htl
        by_cases hle : depth a₁ ≤ depth hd
        · exact ⟨hd, by simp, hhd.1, hhd.2, fun a ha hm he => by
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with heq | hmem
            · subst heq; exact Nat.le_refl _
            · exact Nat.le_trans (hmax₁ a hmem hm he) hle⟩
        · exact ⟨a₁, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ha₁, hm₁, he₁, fun a ha hm he => by
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with heq | hmem
            · subst heq; exact Nat.le_of_not_le hle
            · exact hmax₁ a hmem hm he⟩
      · exact ⟨hd, by simp, hhd.1, hhd.2, fun a ha hm he => by
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with heq | hmem
          · subst heq; exact Nat.le_refl _
          · exact absurd (⟨a, hmem, hm, he⟩ : HasAllow tl r) htl⟩
    · have htl : HasAllow tl r := by
        obtain ⟨a, ha, hm, he⟩ := hHas
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with heq | hmem
        · subst heq; exact absurd ⟨hm, he⟩ hhd
        · exact ⟨a, hmem, hm, he⟩
      obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁, hm₁, he₁, hmax₁⟩ := ih htl
      exact ⟨a₁, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ha₁, hm₁, he₁, fun a ha hm he => by
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with heq | hmem
        · subst heq; exact absurd ⟨hm, he⟩ hhd
        · exact hmax₁ a hmem hm he⟩

theorem covering_of_max {l : List Entry} {r : Request} (hNotPerm : ¬ Permitted l r) {a₀ : Entry} (ha₀ : a₀ ∈ l) (hm₀ : Matches a₀ r) (he₀ : a₀.effect = Effect.allow) (hmax₀ : ∀ a ∈ l, Matches a r → a.effect = Effect.allow → depth a ≤ depth a₀) : ∃ d ∈ l, Matches d r ∧ d.effect = Effect.deny ∧ depth a₀ ≤ depth d := by
  by_cases hEx : ∃ d ∈ l, Matches d r ∧ d.effect = Effect.deny ∧ depth a₀ ≤ depth d
  · exact hEx
  · exfalso
    apply hNotPerm
    refine ⟨a₀, ha₀, hm₀, he₀, fun d hd hm he => ?_⟩
    have hNotLe : ¬ depth a₀ ≤ depth d := fun hle => hEx ⟨d, hd, hm, he, hle⟩
    exact Nat.lt_of_not_le hNotLe

theorem not_hasAllow_or_overridden_of_not_permitted {l : List Entry} {r : Request} (h : ¬ Permitted l r) (hHas : HasAllow l r) : Overridden l r := by
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hm₀, he₀, hmax₀⟩ := exists_max_allow (l:=l) (r:=r) hHas
  obtain ⟨d₀, hd₀, hmD₀, heD₀, hle₀⟩ := covering_of_max h ha₀ hm₀ he₀ hmax₀
  exact ⟨d₀, hd₀, hmD₀, heD₀, fun a ha hm he => Nat.le_trans (hmax₀ a ha hm he) hle₀⟩

theorem permitted_perm {l₁ l₂ : List Entry} (hperm : l₁.Perm l₂) (r : Request) : Permitted l₁ r ↔ Permitted l₂ r := by
  unfold Permitted
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hm, he, hall⟩
    exact ⟨a, hperm.mem_iff.mp ha, hm, he, fun d hd hm2 he2 => hall d (hperm.mem_iff.mpr hd) hm2 he2⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hm, he, hall⟩
    exact ⟨a, hperm.mem_iff.mpr ha, hm, he, fun d hd hm2 he2 => hall d (hperm.mem_iff.mp hd) hm2 he2⟩

theorem decision_perm {l₁ l₂ : List Entry} (hperm : l₁.Perm l₂) (r : Request) : decision l₁ r = decision l₂ r := by
  unfold decision
  have hiff := permitted_perm hperm r
  by_cases h : Permitted l₁ r <;> by_cases h2 : Permitted l₂ r <;> simp_all

theorem decision_true_iff (l : List Entry) (r : Request) : decision l r = true ↔ Permitted l r := by
  unfold decision; simp

theorem decision_false_iff (l : List Entry) (r : Request) : decision l r = false ↔ ¬ Permitted l r := by
  unfold decision; simp

theorem req_valid_answered : ValidAnswered step := by

  · have hf : (step s r).1 = Outcome.rejected := by simp only [step, dif_neg hv]
    rw [hf] at hg

  intro s r hover hg

  · have hf : (step s r).1 = Outcome.rejected := by simp only [step, dif_neg hv]
    rw [hf] at hg
    simp at hg

theorem req_specific_allow : SpecificAllow step := by
  intro s r hv hperm
  have hf : (step s r).1 = if decision s.entries r then Outcome.granted else Outcome.denied := by simp only [step, dif_pos hv]
  rw [hf]
  have hdec : decision s.entries r = true := (decision_true_iff _ _).mpr hperm
  simp [hdec]

  intro s r hg
  by_cases hv : ValidQuery s r
  · have hf : (step s r).1 = if decision s.entries r then Outcome.granted else Outcome.denied := by simp only [step, dif_pos hv]
    rw [hf] at hg
    have hdec : decision s.entries r = true := by
      cases h : decision s.entries r with
      | true => rfl
      | false => simp [h] at hg
    exact (decision_true_iff _ _).mp hdec
  · have hf : (step s r).1 = Outcome.rejected := by simp only [step, dif_neg hv]
    rw [hf] at hg
    simp at hg

theorem req_order_independent : OrderIndependent step := by
  intro s r l hperm
  have hiff : ValidQuery { s with entries := l } r ↔ ValidQuery s r := by

    have h2 : (step { s with entries := l } r).1 = Outcome.rejected := by simp only [step, dif_neg hv2]

theorem req_denial_explained : DenialExplained step := by
  intro s r hden
  by_cases hv : ValidQuery s r
  · have hf : (step s r).1 = if decision s.entries r then Outcome.granted else Outcome.denied := by simp only [step, dif_pos hv]
    rw [hf] at hden

    · exact Or.inr (not_hasAllow_or_overridden_of_not_permitted hnp hHas)
    · exact Or.inl hHas
  · have hf : (step s r).1 = Outcome.rejected := by simp only [step, dif_neg hv]
    rw [hf] at hden
    simp at hden

end Acl
